主要内容: On July 5, 2016, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. (NYSE: SWM) announced the appointment of Daniel Lister as Executive Vice President, Advanced Materials & Structures (AMS), effective July 5, 2016. Don Meltzer, previously holding this position, will transition to head of AMS Strategy. Lister, with experience in packaging, chemical, and lubricant industries, will lead day-to-day operations of the AMS business unit. He previously served as Division President at Greif, Inc., managing a $300 million business unit. SWM's Chairman and CEO, Frédéric Villoutre, highlighted Lister's role in developing the AMS platform. The move aligns with SWM's growth strategy, focusing on diverse end-segments and strategic transformation to diversify its product portfolio.
